scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@ierp/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@ierp/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@ierp/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace=@ierp/shared && npm run dev --workspace=@ierp/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@ierp/shared && npm run build --workspace=@ierp/api && npm run build --workspace=@ierp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@ierp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
